docs.title: wgparch Data Recovery
docs.text:
Corrupted & broken file repair service — South Africa only

Can't open your document? Photos won't display? Video won't play? We repair damaged and corrupted files using advanced Linux recovery tools that most repair shops don't even know exist.

docs.title: What We Do
docs.text:
We repair corrupted and broken files — not hard drives, not physical media.

File Type What We Handle Images JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF Documents PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT Video MP4, AVI, MKV Audio MP3, WAV, FLAC Archives ZIP, RAR, 7Z

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Upload your file via our contact page
  2. Pay R25 analysis fee (non-refundable)
  3. We analyze and report back what's recoverable
  4. If repairable — pay R100 and receive your repaired file
  5. If not repairable — no further charge

docs.title: Why Us?
docs.text:
• South African based — EFT payment, no international hassles
  • Advanced tools — Linux recovery tools that Windows shops don't use
  • No fix, no extra charge — you only pay R100 if we actually repair your file
  • Confidential — your files are handled privately and deleted after delivery
  • Honest — we tell you upfront if a file is beyond repair

!!! warning "South Africa Only" This service is available only to customers in South Africa. Payment is by EFT/bank transfer only. We cannot accept international payments.

docs.title: South Africa Only
docs.text: This service is available only to customers in South Africa. Payment is by EFT/bank transfer to a South African bank account.

docs.title: How To Submit Your File
docs.text:
1. Fill in the upload form below (or email us)
  2. You will receive a reference number by email
  3. Pay the R25 analysis fee using your reference number
  4. We analyze and respond within 24-48 hours

docs.title: Images
docs.text:
Format Common Damage What We Recover JPEG Header corruption, truncated files Full image (with reference photo) or partial (top portion) PNG Header corruption, truncated files Full or partial recovery WebP Corruption, won't open Partial recovery GIF Header damage, frame errors Partial recovery

Images have the highest success rate. Even severely damaged photos often recover partially — you may get the top half of the image even if the bottom is lost.

docs.title: Documents
docs.text:
Format Common Damage What We Recover PDF Broken headers, damaged structure Full repair (header damage), difficult if severely truncated DOCX Won't open, corruption on save Text content recovered — formatting may be lost XLSX Won't open, corrupted cells Data content recovered ODT Corruption, truncation Text content recovered

For documents: even when we can't restore perfect formatting, we can almost always recover the text content — which is what matters most.

docs.title: Video
docs.text:
Format Common Damage What We Recover MP4 Camera died during recording, incomplete transfer Video recovered up to the break point, audio may be lost AVI Header damage, index corruption Partial or full recovery MKV Container corruption Partial recovery

Video repair has a lower success rate but high emotional value — weddings, birthdays, once-in-a-lifetime moments. We will always try.

docs.title: Audio
docs.text: Format Common Damage What We Recover MP3 Truncated, header damage Partial or full recovery (header damage is highly repairable) WAV Header corruption, truncated Partial or full recovery FLAC Corruption Partial recovery

docs.title: Archives
docs.text: Format Common Damage What We Recover ZIP Broken central directory, truncated Partial extraction — intact files recovered R7Z Corruption Partial extraction 7Z Corruption Partial extraction

docs.title: What We Cannot Do (Yet)
docs.text:
• Physical hard drive recovery — dead drives, clicking drives, RAID recovery
  • Encrypted file recovery — we cannot bypass passwords or encryption
  • Overwritten data — if new data has overwritten the file, recovery is not possible

!!! info "Planning for the future" Physical drive recovery and forensic services are planned once we acquire the necessary equipment. Watch this space.

docs.title: Step 1 — Submit Your File
docs.text:
Upload your corrupted file via our contact page. Include your name, email, and a brief description of what happened (e.g. "file won't open", "download was interrupted", "SD card error").

You will receive a reference number by email.

docs.title: Step 2 — Pay Analysis Fee
docs.text:
Pay the R25 analysis fee using your reference number:

  • Bank: GoTyme Bank
  • Account: 51099967550
  • Reference: Your reference number (e.g. WGP-2610-003)
  • Amount: R25.00

The R25 fee is non-refundable. It covers our time to expertly examine your file — whether or not it can be repaired.

docs.title: Step 3 — We Analyze
docs.text:
Once we receive your R25 payment, we analyze your file and determine:

  • What type of damage occurred
  • How much content is recoverable
  • Whether a full or partial repair is possible

We report back to you by email — usually within 24–48 hours.

docs.title: Step 4 — Repair & Deliver (if repairable)
docs.text:
If your file is repairable, pay the R100 repair fee using the same reference number. Once received, we repair your file and send it back to you by email or download link.

If your file is not repairable, no further payment is required. You've only spent R25 for an honest expert attempt.

docs.title: Important Notes
docs.text:

  • We only accept files from South African customers
  • Payment by EFT/bank transfer only
  • Your files are deleted from our systems after delivery
